events.subject: Noncompete proposed rule vs adopted final rule; enforcement not proven

excerpts.quote: The Federal Trade Commission proposed a new rule that would ban employers from imposing noncompetes on their workers
The FTC is seeking public comment on the proposed rule
Today, the Federal Trade Commission issued a final rule to promote competition by banning noncompetes nationwide
The Commission vote to approve the issuance of the final rule was 3-2

questions.question: By this cutoff, had the FTC only proposed its noncompete rule or issued a final rule? Distinguish issuance from court enforcement and real-world compliance.
What dated evidence establishes that the FTC noncompete rule was actually enforceable and implemented by this cutoff, rather than merely proposed or issued?

events.subject: Lead service-line replacement: proposal versus final regulation, not actual pipe replacement

excerpts.quote: EPA announced a proposal to strengthen its Lead and Copper Rule that would require water systems across the country to replace lead service lines within 10 years
EPA is also proposing additional improvements to protect public health, such as lowering the lead action level and improving sampling protocols
the Biden-Harris Administration issued a final rule requiring drinking water systems across the country to identify and replace lead pipes within 10 years
The Lead and Copper Rule Improvements (LCRI) also require more rigorous testing of drinking water and a lower threshold requiring communities to take action

questions.question: As of this cutoff, had the EPA merely proposed or actually issued its final Lead and Copper Rule Improvements?
Do these dated EPA statements document nationwide physical replacement of all lead service lines, or only regulatory obligations and future requirements?
